summary: Validated the 6 backend areas requested after the sessionStorage / subscription-refresh changes. 13/13 pytest cases pass against the public preview URL. Verified: (1) POST /api/auth/subscribe (yearly) and POST /api/subscription/activate-code both update subscription.expiresAt and an IMMEDIATE GET /api/auth/profile reflects the new value (no DB lag, no caching) — confirming the new authAPI.getProfile() call works; (2) POST /api/ambassador/profile/currency persists USD/EUR/CDF and POST /api/ambassador/dashboard returns the value at ambassador.preferredCurrency; rejects 'ZZZ' with 400; (3) POST /api/admin/login still validates against ADMIN_PASSWORD (200 for correct, 401 for wrong); (4) POST /api/admin/ambassadors/list still accepts adminPassword body field and returns a list of ambassador dicts (id/name/email/country/status); (5) GET /api/admin and GET /api/admin/ambassador-panel return 200 HTML containing both 'sessionStorage' and 'tryRestoreSession' — the F5-persistence JS is wired up; (6) POST /api/auth/refresh with a valid JWT returns success:true + new token (≠ old) + user + expiresInDays:365. No issues found, no backend signatures broken by the change. Test ambassador credentials in the request body (jfellykap@gmail.com / Felly2025) returned 401 on the live system so the test now creates a throwaway ambassador via /api/admin/ambassadors/create — see action_items.

minor.issue: The credentials documented in the review request (jfellykap@gmail.com / Felly2025) return 401 'Email ou mot de passe incorrect' against the live preview backend. The ambassador document exists (listed by /api/admin/ambassadors/list), so either the password was changed or never matched what was documented. Also: the seeded test ambassador in /app/memory/test_credentials.md (ambassador@tekateka.com / Ambassador2025) returns 403 'Compte bloqué' so it's currently blocked. Workaround in tests: create a throwaway ambassador via /api/admin/ambassadors/create then delete it in teardown.

Handler returns None implicitly (no return statement) at ambassador_api.py:855 after updating the status. FastAPI will serialise that to 'null' with 200 OK — fine, but inconsistent with the rest of the admin endpoints which return {success:true,...}. Not in scope of this review but worth noting.

passlib bcrypt backend logs 'AttributeError: module bcrypt has no attribute __about__' warning on every ambassador login (passlib 1.7.x vs bcrypt 4.x incompatibility). Logins still work because passlib falls back to a different version probe, but the noise pollutes the error log. Suggestion: pin bcrypt<4 or upgrade passlib.

action_items: Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md or reset jfellykap@gmail.com's password — the credential 'Felly2025' no longer authenticates. The seeded ambassador@tekateka.com is also blocked, so neither documented credential currently works for direct ambassador login. The test now seeds & tears down its own ambassador to remain hermetic, but human testers will trip over this.
Optional: silence passlib/bcrypt warning by pinning bcrypt<4 or upgrading passlib.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/auth/subscribe (data_api.py:769) and POST /api/subscription/activate-code (ambassador_api.py:602) both correctly write to user.subscription.expiresAt — GET /api/auth/profile (data_api.py:266) reads the same field directly from MongoDB, so the immediate-refresh contract holds without any cache invalidation logic. Good.

ambassador_api.py:280 reads ambassador.get('preferredCurrency', 'EUR') as the default — matches the whitelist default and means a new ambassador without the field set returns 'EUR' rather than crashing. Good.
_ALLOWED_CURRENCIES in ambassador_api.py:303 correctly whitelists currency input — uppercase normalisation happens before the check (line 317). Reject of 'ZZZ' returns 400, confirmed by test.

admin_api.py:558 wires tryRestoreSession() to DOMContentLoaded — so the F5 refresh path is correct. Both pages use the same SESSION_KEY pattern and re-validate against /admin/login on restore (admin_api.py:425, admin_ambassador_panel.py:138-ish). Good — no plaintext-password persistence beyond sessionStorage's tab lifetime.
POST /api/auth/refresh (data_api.py:274) is unchanged from iteration_2 and still behaves correctly (200/401/404). No regression.

success_rate.frontend: N/A — backend-only test request per review

seed_data_creation: Each test creates its own throwaway data and cleans up: (1) phone-login user with a unique +243* phone, deleted via DELETE /api/account/me at module teardown; (2) the activate-code test creates a second throwaway phone-login user inline and deletes it in a finally block; (3) a throwaway ambassador (email test-amb-<ts>-<rand>@tekateka-test.local, password TestAmb2025!) is seeded via POST /api/admin/ambassadors/create and deleted via POST /api/admin/ambassadors/delete at module teardown — the latter also wipes any unused codes generated by the activate-code test. No persistent residue, safe to re-run.

rca_of_issue: No bug found in the change set under review. The sessionStorage F5-persistence JS is correctly served on both admin pages, and the new authAPI.getProfile() pattern on the mobile side will receive a fully-updated subscription.expiresAt because /api/auth/profile reads it directly from MongoDB after activate-code/subscribe have committed.
